description: This file defines the NoteRepository class responsible for managing CRUD operations and query functionalities for Note objects within a local SQLite database. It provides methods to insert, retrieve (with filtering by search query or date), update, and delete notes. Additionally, it references auxiliary classes for database schema and Note model.

classes.name: NoteRepository
classes.description: Repository class managing CRUD and query operations for Note objects in a SQLite database.

methods.name: insertNote
methods.description: Inserts a new Note into the database and returns the row ID of the newly inserted note.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Notes filtered optionally by search query and/or creation date.

methods.name: getNoteById
methods.description: Retrieves a single Note by its unique ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing Note in the database.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a Note from the database by its ID.
